name: Boston Dynamics
short_description: World leader in athletic legged robots with the Spot and Atlas platforms.
why_relevant: Defined what is physically possible in quadruped and humanoid robotics.

name: Figure AI
short_description: Developer of the Figure 01/02 general-purpose humanoid robot.
why_relevant: Commercial push for humanoids in logistics and manufacturing.

name: Agility Robotics
short_description: Creator of Digit, a humanoid robot built for warehouse logistics.
why_relevant: First humanoids deployed in real logistics customer operations.

name: Unitree Robotics
short_description: Builds quadrupeds and the G1 humanoid at consumer-affordable prices.
why_relevant: Brought legged robotics costs down dramatically worldwide.

name: 1X Technologies
short_description: Developer of the NEO home humanoid with an OpenAI-backed vision.
why_relevant: Betting on software-driven humanoids for consumer environments.

name: Sanctuary AI
short_description: Builds the Phoenix humanoid guided by a teleoperation-trained AI.
why_relevant: Combines human-in-the-loop training with general-purpose robots.

name: Apptronik
short_description: Developer of Apollo, a humanoid designed for industrial shifts.
why_relevant: Partnered with major industries to move toward humanoid workforces.

name: ANYbotics
short_description: Maker of ANYmal, an autonomous quadruped for industrial inspection.
why_relevant: Proved legged robots can replace humans in hazardous plant inspection.

name: Fourier Intelligence
short_description: Builds the GR humanoid series and rehabilitation exoskeletons.
why_relevant: Bridges clinical rehab robotics and general humanoids.

name: Skild AI
short_description: Builds a shared brain foundation model for embodied agents.
why_relevant: Argues robot skills should be a single learnable foundation model.

name: Physical Intelligence
short_description: Developer of the pi generalist robot foundation model.
why_relevant: Leading effort toward one model that controls many robots.

name: Intrinsic
short_description: Alphabet company building AI software to make industrial robots easier to use.
why_relevant: Attacks the cost of programming industrial robots.

name: Bright Machines
short_description: Builds microfactories that combine robots and software for assembly.
why_relevant: Rebundles AI, vision and robots into a drop-in manufacturing cell.

name: Universal Robots
short_description: Inventor of the mass-market collaborative robot arm (cobot).
why_relevant: Created the ubiquitous cobot category, now part of Teradyne.

name: Locus Robotics
short_description: Deploys fleets of autonomous mobile robots for warehouse fulfillment.
why_relevant: Proven multi-billion-unit throughput partner of major logistics firms.

name: Dexterity
short_description: Builds robotic systems for depalletizing and box handling in warehouses.
why_relevant: Reliable high-throughput case handling in real distribution centers.

name: Covariant
short_description: Develops the RFM-1 foundation model for general robot manipulation.
why_relevant: Pioneered learning-from-data general grasping in logistics.

name: Chef Robotics
short_description: Builds robots that assemble and plate food in high-volume kitchens.
why_relevant: Tackles the highest-turnover job category in food service.

name: Galbot
short_description: Builds wheeled humanoid robots for warehouse and retrieval tasks.
why_relevant: Strong material-handling deployment cadence in Chinese logistics.

name: Clone Robotics
short_description: Builds humanoids with synthetic muscles and bones.
why_relevant: Radical actuator approach modeled on human musculoskeletal structure.

name: Rainbow Robotics
short_description: Developer of the RB series humanoid, now backed by Samsung.
why_relevant: South Korea's flagship humanoid builder backed by Samsung.

name: Xpeng Robotics
short_description: EV maker's robotics arm developing the Iron humanoid.
why_relevant: Ties EV-level engineering to humanoid manufacturing.

name: Nuro
short_description: Builds the R2 curb-side delivery robot for local commerce.
why_relevant: Commercial curb-to-door robot delivery with major retail partners.

name: Serve Robotics
short_description: Operates self-driving sidewalk robots for food delivery.
why_relevant: Public Nasdaq company scaling robotic last-mile delivery.

name: Cartken
short_description: Provides AI-driven sidewalk robots backed by major tech partners.
why_relevant: White-label autonomy for last-mile robot fleets.

name: Sarcos Technology
short_description: Develops powered exoskeletons and teleoperated robots for industry.
why_relevant: Ergonomic augmentation for physically demanding industrial jobs.

name: Ekso Bionics
short_description: Builds wearable exoskeletons for stroke rehab and mobility.
why_relevant: Evidence-based exoskeleton therapy used in hospitals.

name: Mujin
short_description: Develops controller technology enabling mixed-lot robotic depalletizing.
why_relevant: Sells a universal brain for hard industrial motion tasks.

name: Clearpath Robotics
short_description: Maker of the Otto line of autonomous industrial vehicles.
why_relevant: Canada's answer to heavy-load autonomous material transport.

name: Vention
short_description: Platform to design, simulate and deploy robotic workcells in one day.
why_relevant: Brings no-code configuration to industrial automation.
